newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 drops to s/a 25.12 bln stg week to April 16.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 drops to s/a 25.12 bln stg week to April 16.

text.p: British M0 money supply edged down to a seasonally adjusted 25.12 billion stg in the week to April 16 from 25.155 billion the week before, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 fell to 24.88 billion stg from 24.906 billion the previous week.

Notes and coins in circulation were also slightly lower on a seasonally adjusted basis at 24.904 bilion stg from 25.023 billion. Unadjusted notes and coins fell to 24.664 billion stg from 24.774 billion.
